scope: Same-device H100 FP16 and ordinary per-tensor FP8 routed-expert kernel pipelines. No routing-network/shared-expert/communication/host/serving measurement.

fp16.timing_scope: First-to-last CUPTI activity span from a single-call graph replay
fp16.scope: FP16 routed-expert GPU pipeline with precomputed routing, including required adapters, activation and combine; excludes host enqueue, weight preparation, routing selection, shared experts, communication and serving
fp16.native_search: coordinate search plus top-two pair combinations and default; not exhaustive

fp8.timing_scope: First-to-last CUPTI activity span from a single-call graph replay
fp8.scope: Per-tensor FP8 routed-expert GPU pipeline with precomputed routing, including required adapters, activation and combine; excludes host enqueue, weight preparation, routing selection, shared experts, communication and serving
fp8.native_search: coordinate search plus top-two pair combinations and default; not exhaustive
